site.title: StartupInspire
site.short_description: Startup directory with a free listing path and a €5 Starter plan for instant approval. OpenQuok autofills the dashboard startup form; checkout and publish stay on StartupInspire.
site.long_description: StartupInspire publishes startups at /startup/your-slug with a primary website button. Compare free vs paid on StartupInspire pricing and read FAQ for one-time Starter payment and instant approval. OpenQuok fills create startup after you sign in; plan choice, social fields, and reCAPTCHA stay manual.

opportunities.title: Free listing
opportunities.cost_note: €0 for one startup; manual review (typically 3–7 business days); no instant approval.
opportunities.description: List one startup on StartupInspire at no cost. OpenQuok fills the dashboard startup form after you sign in. Submit on the free tier from StartupInspire pricing. Confirm link treatment on your live /startup/… page after publish.

steps.title: Sign up or sign in
steps.body: Create a StartupInspire account or sign in at StartupInspire login.

steps.title: Open the startup form
steps.body: Open the create startup form, or your edit URL for an existing draft.

steps.title: Autofill and submit free tier
steps.body: Use OpenQuok to fill name, headline, description, website, logo, and category or technology fields. Complete social links and reCAPTCHA on StartupInspire. Submit for free-tier review.

steps.title: Verify live page and rel
steps.body: When StartupInspire publishes your listing, open your live startup page. Confirm the primary website button has no nofollow. Save your live listing URL.

opportunities.title: Starter launch
opportunities.cost_note: €5 one-time (Starter); instant approval; confirm rel on your live /startup/… page after publish.
opportunities.description: Pay €5 for Starter on StartupInspire for instant approval and homepage visibility. OpenQuok fills create startup first; Starter checkout and publish stay on StartupInspire. Paid Starter does not change website link rel vs free on current profile pages — verify after publish.

steps.title: Compare plans
steps.body: Compare free listing vs Starter (€5, instant approval) on StartupInspire pricing and in the FAQ.

steps.title: Sign up or sign in
steps.body: Create a StartupInspire account or sign in at StartupInspire login, then open the create startup form.

steps.title: Autofill with OpenQuok
steps.body: Use OpenQuok to complete core startup fields. Finish any remaining social or compliance fields on StartupInspire.

steps.title: Pay Starter
steps.body: Complete the €5 Starter one-time payment on StartupInspire for instant approval.

steps.title: Verify live page
steps.body: Open your live startup page. Confirm the website CTA works and has no nofollow. Save your live listing URL.
